description_sq:
Shitet Duplex te Tirana Garden Building prane rruges se Kavajes, shume prane qendres se Tiranes. 
Duplex-i organizohet si me poshte:
Kati i pare perbehet nga dhoma e ndenjes, ambjent i vecuar per kuzhinen dhe ngrenien, ballkon dhe nje tualet,
Kati i dyte perbehet nga 2 dhoma gjumi nga te cilat njera me garderobe dhe nje tualet. 
Shitet i mobiluar. Mobilimi eshte cilesor e luksoz.
Ndertesa eshte nje nga me te mirat ne Tirane, perfunduar ne vitet e fundit, duke ofruar cilesi ndertimi, komoditet dhe prestigj. 
Gjithashtu, kopshtet e varuara permiresojne karakteristikat ambjentale te nderteses dhe ofrojne freski per banoret dhe sherbimet e vendosura ne godine. 
Keto te fundit, ofrojne facilitetet e nevojshme per banoret dhe zonen.
Per me shume información, na kontaktoni!
description_en: Duplex for sale in Tirana Garden Building near Kavaje street, very close to the center of Tirana. The duplex is organized as follows: The first floor consists of a living room, a separate kitchen and dining area, a balcony and a toilet, the second floor consists of 2 bedrooms, one of which has a wardrobe and a toilet. For sale furnished. The furniture is high quality and luxurious. The building is one of the best in Tirana, completed in recent years, offering quality construction, comfort and prestige. Also, the hanging gardens improve the environmental characteristics of the building and provide freshness for the residents and the services located in the building. The latter offer the necessary facilities for residents and the area. For more information, contact us!
